pages.text: Dodge $(l)through$() attacks, not away from them: you're briefly untouchable mid-roll.$(br2)Guarding takes hits on your stamina. Guard at the last moment with the right skill and you'll $(l)parry$(), leaving your foe open.$(br2)Each weapon has an $(l)innate skill$(), a special move; skill books found in the world teach new ones ($(l)K$() to equip).
